name: course-platform-caption-quality-gate
purpose: Shared preflight checks for SRT/VTT files used in course platforms.

checks.rule: startMs >= 0 AND endMs > startMs AND startMs >= previous.endMs
checks.failure: Reject overlapping or backwards subtitle intervals.

checks.rule: text is valid UTF-8 and contains no NUL

checks.failure: Reject a format the selected course platform does not document.
Keep the file in draft; this template never logs in or publishes.

output.telemetry: Record aggregate pass/fail counts only; do not log media or caption text.
